verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents `humanlayer automation run` for running a Cloud-visible coding session non-interactively from a CI job, a cron machine, or a server script, so recurring runs are possible. Scheduling itself is delegated to external cron or CI rather than handled by a built-in scheduler. missing for 10: native recurring schedule/trigger configuration within HumanLayer, multi-step workflow scheduling, schedule management/monitoring docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
